title: Article header: a centred clay pixel tile, the title, a deck and three meta columns with mono labels
use: The top of an article or a post card: tile icon, 36-unit title, deck, then AUTHOR / CATEGORY / PUBLISHED between two hairlines. glyph picks the tile's pixel glyph.
